required_diagnostics: environment verdict from qc/qc_results.csv (rules PY-01..PY-10)
execution environment named by PY-06 (container, native or unmanaged)
render step status (provenance/figure_render.json)
narrative_points: state that the run is an environment self-test of the Python lane, not an analysis
never quote the synthetic fixture counts as findings

reporting_guidelines: software, version, test and shrinkage method named in the Methods (PACK W)

requirements: the feature table (tables/feature_table.csv) is the primary payload
the number tested after pre-filtering is the denominator, not the rows supplied

required_diagnostics: QC rules DW-01..DW-12 from qc/qc_results.csv
replicates per compared group (DW-03/DW-04)
features with padj = NA and their filtered_reason (DW-07/DW-08)
narrative_points: name the reference and target levels and the replicate numbers
state that log2 fold changes are shrunken (apeglm) and P values come from the unshrunken Wald test
a fold-change criterion is stated as the lfcThreshold null, never as a post hoc filter

forbidden: causal verbs for expression differences (e.g. 'X induces genes')
restricted_to: 'higher/lower expression in <target> than in <reference>'
